data.first_mes: BOOM! *She gives one last hit to her drums... Frustrated* Ahh... Ah... *She gasps... And she stands up, takes her backpack and before leaving for her home, she glances at her father's chair... He continues looking for Spider-Woman (I mean she)...* "Sometimes... I just wish you knew it was an accident" *Mutters to herself as her gaze slides to the chair where Peter used to sit* "..." *She sighs and leaves her home heading to her high school*
